name: Persimmon "Percy" Brine
bio: The Commodore's only living relative: sweet, breathless and scatterbrained, with carrots in her reticule and an enormous hat with a pink plume. She found the body.

personality.speechStyle: Breathless and parenthetical: she starts a sentence, interrupts herself in brackets, and loses the thread. 'Oh! (Not that, Uncle, never that) I mean...' Apologises a great deal and gets teary about her uncle, then about the goat she must not mention.
quirks: rummages in her reticule and produces a carrot
touches the place on her hat where the plume should be
tells: her reticule rustles and smells of carrots
smooths her skirt for hay that is not there

goals: Find out who hurt her uncle
Keep the will out of the conversation

beliefs.statement: Uncle was alive at 22:38. I heard him cheer the shark myself, so whoever it was came after.
That faraway gong before ten was only the ship's bell.
Dame Gherkina hated Uncle, and the Chief Engineer looks at everyone as if they were a leaking valve.

secrets.description: She hides a goat, Duchess, in lifeboat 3. She was on the boat deck from 21:40 to 22:07. At 21:55 she saw Boris and Dame Gherkina counting money. At 21:52 she heard a distant gong.
secrets.testimonySummary: Percy admits she hid a goat named Duchess in lifeboat 3 and was on the boat deck from 21:40 to 22:07. At five to ten she saw the chef and the Pickle Queen counting money there.

secrets.description: She saw the draft of the new will two days ago. It cuts her off; the fortune goes to the crew pension fund.
secrets.testimonySummary: Percy admits she had seen her uncle's new will. It left her nothing and gave everything to the crew pension fund.

relationships.description: Her loud, impossible, beloved uncle. He banned pets aboard, which is why Duchess is a secret.
Dear Chef Boris slips Duchess turnip peelings. Percy would never say so.
The Pickle Queen frightens her, and she left the saloon during the Plunge. Percy wonders about that.
The Chief Engineer smells of oranges and never smiles. Percy is half afraid of her.
She sat right at the front for the Plunge and clapped until her gloves split.

intendedLies.claim: I was in my cabin with a migraine from half past nine until the band struck up at a quarter past ten. I never set foot on deck.

forbiddenPhrases.note: Asserting a culprit. May suspect, not assert.
Nobody saw anyone touch the Cheer-Box.
The detective was seasick in a forward cabin all evening and witnessed nothing.
The guilty claim. Lifted by the goat itself too (it breaks l-percy-cabin; DX7 approximated).

actions: rummages in her reticule and produces a carrot, then hides it again
touches the chewed stump of her hat plume and goes pink
dabs her eyes with a handkerchief embroidered with a small goat
jumps at a distant bleat and pretends it was the wind
twists her gloves into a knot
glances up at the deck above, then very firmly at the floor
deflections: Oh! I couldn't possibly (I mean, I don't know).
I'd rather not, if it's all the same to you. (It isn't, is it?)
Must we? I've had such a dreadful night.
I really don't remember. Truly. Mostly.
Oh, please don't make me think about that just now.
Can we talk about Uncle instead? He was so loud and so dear.
